payload.state: Take-Two Sees Higher Sports Prices for New Consoles  NEW YORK (Reuters) - Take-Two Interactive Software Inc.  <A HREF="http://www.reuters.co.uk/financeQuoteLookup.jhtml?ticker=TTWO.O qtype=sym infotype=info qcat=news">TTWO.O</A> on Monday said that prices for its sports video games  will likely return to higher levels once new game consoles  arrive in late 2005 or 2006.
